1. GitHub Actions (PR lane) runs tests + lints on every PR
2. On main, Cloud Build builds JVM + web with multi-stage Docker
3. Pushes images to Artifact Registry
4. Bumps image tags in <tt>infra/k8s/*</tt> (main only)
5. Argo CD reconciles dev cluster from Git

<b>Secret flow</b>

div.div:
Legend
■ gray boxes — non-GCP code (clients, our services)
■ blue — GKE edge layer
■ red — backend services (Spring Boot)
■ GCP-icon nodes — managed services
■ purple — CI/CD + secrets
— solid — synchronous request
- - dashed — async / verification

div.div:
CI/CD flow
1. GitHub Actions (PR lane) runs tests + lints on every PR
2. On main, Cloud Build builds JVM + web with multi-stage Docker
3. Pushes images to Artifact Registry
4. Bumps image tags in infra/k8s/* (main only)
5. Argo CD reconciles dev cluster from Git
Secret flow
